formation.note: No fetched source states a formation date.

intervals.label: assembly completed and commissioning
intervals.note: Start = completion of the basic assembly of the Demonstrator at LSM (November 2018); the sources do not date the start of commissioning itself, nor the earlier construction. The 2018-2020 report says 'The calorimeter is fully commissioned and the tracker commissioning is under progress'; a December 2024 paper still speaks of 'the final stages of installation and commissioning'.
intervals.quote: The most important result is the completion of the basic assembly of the SuperNEMO Demonstrator in November 2018

intervals.label: data taking
intervals.note: First ββ event recorded 10 April 2025; the June 2025 status talk reports 'Now in full data taking mode'. No later source was found, so whether data taking continues on 2026-10-26 is not confirmed.

name: SuperNEMO Collaboration
notes: Membership counts (95 participants, 7 countries, 22 institutions, as of January 2021) come from a collaboration talk, not an official roster, so they are not entered as membership counts. Quote: 'SuperNEMO – successor of NEMO-3 is international collaboration 95 participants from 7 countries, 22 institutions'.

summary.plain: The international collaboration, about 95 people at 22 institutions in 7 countries in January 2021, that is building SuperNEMO and running its first module in Modane.
summary.technical: Collaboration building SuperNEMO, successor to NEMO-3; JINR PAC talk (21 January 2021): 95 participants from 7 countries and 22 institutions.
